artifact: Artifact JSON filename used for this test.
test_id: Identifier of the test combination in the artifact.
initial_condition: Starting state values, ordered like the model state names.
target: Desired state values, ordered like the model state names.
scenario_name: Name of the selected test scenario.
agent_mode: Mock mode or the language model used for tuning.
total_complexity: Manually assigned test difficulty, filled during finalization.
success_rate: Score calculated from the separate verification run during finalization; higher is better, not a tuning-iteration result.

best_params.Np: Best candidate selected across tuning: number of future time steps predicted by MPC.
best_params.Nc: Best candidate selected across tuning: number of future control moves optimized by MPC.
Q: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights deciding how strongly each state error is penalized.
R: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights deciding how strongly control-input use is penalized.
P: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights on state error at the end of the prediction horizon.
best_params.dt: Best candidate selected across tuning: effective sampling interval in seconds, resolved by the tuning summary.

tuning.best_cost: Best candidate across tuning: lowest composite cost found among eligible evaluated candidates.
tuning.best_mse: Best candidate across tuning: MSE from the candidate with the lowest composite cost; not necessarily the smallest MSE.
tuning.iterations: Final tuning iteration counter; not the number of simulation timesteps or total agent calls.
tuning.termination_reason: At the end of tuning: latest reason the Terminator requested a Juror review.
tuning.juror_verdict: At the end of tuning: latest Juror decision about acceptance or further tuning.

token_usage.simulated: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: whether these are generated mock counts and costs, rather than real API usage.
token_usage.prompt_tokens: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: total recorded input tokens.
token_usage.completion_tokens: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: total recorded output tokens.
token_usage.total_tokens: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded input plus output tokens.
token_usage.call_count: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: number of recorded model calls.
token_usage.unparsed_calls: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded calls whose token counts could not be read.

<model_name>.prompt: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded input tokens for this model.
<model_name>.completion: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded output tokens for this model.
<model_name>.total: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded input plus output tokens for this model.

token_usage.cost_usd: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: estimated US-dollar cost of recorded tokens; synthetic in mock mode.
unpriced_models: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: model name without a price entry; its cost cannot be estimated.

tuning.completed: Whether the tuning workflow finished without a streaming exception; does not mean the controller achieved its target.

final_state.system_name: Name of the dynamic model stored in workflow memory.
state_names: State variable name, in model order.

current_params.Np: Candidate parameters held when tuning ended; may differ from the last evaluated or best candidate: number of future time steps predicted by MPC.
current_params.Nc: Candidate parameters held when tuning ended; may differ from the last evaluated or best candidate: number of future control moves optimized by MPC.
Q: Candidate parameters held when tuning ended; may differ from the last evaluated or best candidate: weights deciding how strongly each state error is penalized.
R: Candidate parameters held when tuning ended; may differ from the last evaluated or best candidate: weights deciding how strongly control-input use is penalized.
P: Candidate parameters held when tuning ended; may differ from the last evaluated or best candidate: weights on state error at the end of the prediction horizon.
current_params.dt: Candidate parameters held when tuning ended; may differ from the last evaluated or best candidate: time between controller updates in seconds; raw null means keep the active interval.

final_state.strategy: Current tuning strategy, such as exploration or refinement.
final_state.actor_reasoning: At the end of tuning: latest Actor explanation of its proposed parameters; not a new simulation result.
final_state.current_mse: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average squared difference between actual and target values, over all states and times.
final_state.current_overshoot: Last evaluated tuning simulation: largest amount a state went past its target, divided by that state initial error.
final_state.current_settling: Last evaluated tuning simulation: seconds until error became small and stayed small enough; if not settled, this is the duration-based fallback, not an achieved settling time.
final_state.current_effort: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average squared control input; this field is not actually RMS despite its name.

current_per_state_mse.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average squared tracking error for this state over the simulation.

current_per_state_overshoot.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: amount this state went past its target, divided by its starting error; null if not calculable.

current_per_state_iae.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: absolute tracking error for this state accumulated over simulation time.

current_per_state_ise.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: squared tracking error for this state accumulated over simulation time.

final_state.current_is_regulation: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether all state targets stayed constant throughout the simulation.
final_state.current_oscillation_count: Last evaluated tuning simulation: number of error sign changes for the state with the largest starting error.
final_state.current_unstable: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether the simulator detected divergence or a state-bound violation.
final_state.avg_solve_time: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average seconds spent solving one MPC optimization.
final_state.eval_error: At the end of tuning: latest evaluation failure message, if any; retained metrics may come from an earlier evaluation.

metrics.MSE: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average squared difference between actual and target values, over all states and times.
metrics.Max_Overshoot: Last evaluated tuning simulation: largest amount a state went past its target, divided by that state initial error.
metrics.Overshoot_Meaningful: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether any state has a constant target and a nonzero starting error, making overshoot calculable.
metrics.Settling_Time: Last evaluated tuning simulation: seconds until error became small and stayed small enough; if not settled, this is the duration-based fallback, not an achieved settling time.
metrics.Settled: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether error became small and passed the minimum-duration and hold checks.
metrics.Is_Stable: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether error settled or did not grow significantly from the first to the last quarter; not a formal stability proof.
metrics.Control_Effort_RMS: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average squared control input; this field is not actually RMS despite its name.
metrics.Oscillation_Count: Last evaluated tuning simulation: number of error sign changes for the state with the largest starting error.

Per_State_MSE.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: average squared tracking error for this state over the simulation.

Per_State_Overshoot.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: amount this state went past its target, divided by its starting error; null if not calculable.

metrics.Integral_Abs_Error: Last evaluated tuning simulation: absolute tracking error accumulated over time, summed over all states.
metrics.Integral_Sq_Error: Last evaluated tuning simulation: squared tracking error accumulated over time, summed over all states.

Per_State_IAE.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: absolute tracking error for this state accumulated over simulation time.

Per_State_ISE.<state_name>: Last evaluated tuning simulation: squared tracking error for this state accumulated over simulation time.

metrics.Is_Regulation: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether all state targets stayed constant throughout the simulation.

Improvement.MSE: Last evaluated tuning simulation: percentage reduction in squared tracking error versus the best-cost candidate held BEFORE this evaluation; positive means better.
Improvement.Overshoot: Last evaluated tuning simulation: percentage reduction in overshoot versus the best-cost candidate held BEFORE this evaluation; positive means better.
Improvement.Settling_Time: Last evaluated tuning simulation: percentage reduction in settling time versus the best-cost candidate held BEFORE this evaluation; positive means better.
Improvement.Control_Effort: Last evaluated tuning simulation: percentage reduction in input use versus the best-cost candidate held BEFORE this evaluation; positive means better.

metrics.Scenario_Level: Last evaluated tuning simulation: scenario level used for this simulation.
metrics.Cost: Last evaluated tuning simulation: combined tracking, overshoot, settling and input-use penalties, using the chosen cost weights.
metrics.Unstable: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether the simulator detected divergence or a state-bound violation.
metrics.Unstable_Reason: Last evaluated tuning simulation: reason for detected divergence or a state-bound violation, if any.

Solver_Diagnostics.solved: Last evaluated tuning simulation: number of MPC optimizations reported as solved.
Solver_Diagnostics.solved_inaccurate: Last evaluated tuning simulation: number reported as solved with reduced accuracy.
Solver_Diagnostics.other: Last evaluated tuning simulation: number with any other recorded solver status.

metrics.Dt_Mpc: Last evaluated tuning simulation: time between MPC control updates, in seconds.

states: Last evaluated tuning simulation stored when tuning ended: actual state values at each recorded time; one row per time sample and one column per state.
inputs: Last evaluated tuning simulation stored when tuning ended: applied control values at each control step; one row per step and one column per input.
refs: Last evaluated tuning simulation stored when tuning ended: desired state values at each recorded time; not the actual plant states.
times: Last evaluated tuning simulation stored when tuning ended: simulation timestamps in seconds, aligned with the state rows.
simulation_data.n_states: Last evaluated tuning simulation stored when tuning ended: number of state columns in the saved trajectory.
simulation_data.n_inputs: Last evaluated tuning simulation stored when tuning ended: number of input columns in the saved trajectory.

final_state.success: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether error became small and passed the minimum-duration and hold checks.
final_state.unstable: Last evaluated tuning simulation: whether the simulator detected divergence or a state-bound violation.
final_state.exploration_strategy: Tuning exploration strategy retained in workflow memory.
final_state.best_mse: Best candidate across tuning: MSE from the candidate with the lowest composite cost; not necessarily the smallest MSE.
final_state.best_cost: Best candidate across tuning: lowest composite cost found among eligible evaluated candidates.

best_params.Np: Best candidate selected across tuning: number of future time steps predicted by MPC.
best_params.Nc: Best candidate selected across tuning: number of future control moves optimized by MPC.
Q: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights deciding how strongly each state error is penalized.
R: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights deciding how strongly control-input use is penalized.
P: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights on state error at the end of the prediction horizon.
best_params.dt: Best candidate selected across tuning: time between controller updates in seconds; raw null means keep the active interval.

final_state.best_overshoot: Best candidate across tuning: overshoot from the candidate with the lowest composite cost.
final_state.best_settling: Best candidate across tuning: settling-time metric from the candidate with the lowest composite cost.
final_state.best_effort: Best candidate across tuning: average squared input from the candidate with the lowest composite cost.
mse_history: History for the whole tuning run: MSE of each evaluated tuning candidate, in evaluation order; not one value per timestep.
overshoot_history: History for the whole tuning run: overshoot of each evaluated tuning candidate, in evaluation order; not one value per timestep.
settling_history: History for the whole tuning run: settling-time metric of each evaluated tuning candidate, in evaluation order.
effort_history: History for the whole tuning run: average squared input of each evaluated tuning candidate, in evaluation order.

params_history.Np: One evaluated tuning candidate in history: number of future time steps predicted by MPC.
params_history.Nc: One evaluated tuning candidate in history: number of future control moves optimized by MPC.
Q: One evaluated tuning candidate in history: weights deciding how strongly each state error is penalized.
R: One evaluated tuning candidate in history: weights deciding how strongly control-input use is penalized.
P: One evaluated tuning candidate in history: weights on state error at the end of the prediction horizon.
params_history.dt: One evaluated tuning candidate in history: time between controller updates in seconds; raw null means keep the active interval.

final_state.critic_feedback: At the end of tuning: latest Critic advice based on the latest available evaluation.
final_state.should_continue: Internal decision about whether the tuning workflow should continue.
final_state.termination_reason: At the end of tuning: latest reason the Terminator requested a Juror review.
final_state.juror_verdict: At the end of tuning: latest Juror decision about acceptance or further tuning.
final_state.iteration: When tuning ended: tuning iteration counter; not a simulation timestep.
final_state.max_iterations: Configured maximum number of tuning iterations.
history: All agent and evaluator messages collected during tuning, in chronological order; not a state trajectory.
final_state.ui_scenario_level: Scenario level supplied to the tuning workflow.
final_state.user_guidance: User instructions describing the desired control behavior.

cost_weights.mse: Weight multiplying the mse metric in the composite tuning cost.

cost_weights.oscillation: Weight multiplying the oscillation metric in the composite tuning cost.

final_state.dt_mpc: At the end of tuning: active controller interval in seconds; the latest evaluated interval is metrics.Dt_Mpc.

metrics.mse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared difference between actual and target values, over all states and times.
metrics.rmse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: square root of average squared tracking error over all states and times.
metrics.overshoot: Separate verification simulation with best_params: largest amount a state went past its target, divided by that state initial error.
metrics.overshoot_meaningful: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether any state has a constant target and a nonzero starting error, making overshoot calculable.
metrics.settling_time: Separate verification simulation with best_params: seconds until error became small and stayed small enough; if not settled, this is the duration-based fallback, not an achieved settling time.
metrics.settled: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether error became small and passed the minimum-duration and hold checks.
metrics.is_stable: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether error settled or did not grow significantly from the first to the last quarter; not a formal stability proof.
metrics.control_effort: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared applied input over all control steps; smaller means less input use.
metrics.oscillation_count: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number of error sign changes for the state with the largest starting error.
per_state_mse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared tracking error for one state, in state-name order.
per_state_overshoot: Separate verification simulation with best_params: overshoot fraction for one state, in state-name order; null if not calculable.
metrics.integral_abs_error: Separate verification simulation with best_params: absolute tracking error accumulated over time, summed over all states.
metrics.integral_sq_error: Separate verification simulation with best_params: squared tracking error accumulated over time, summed over all states.
per_state_iae: Separate verification simulation with best_params: absolute tracking error accumulated over time for one state, in state-name order.
per_state_ise: Separate verification simulation with best_params: squared tracking error accumulated over time for one state, in state-name order.
metrics.is_regulation: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether all state targets stayed constant throughout the simulation.

states: Verification with best_params: actual state values at each recorded time; one row per time sample.
inputs: Verification with best_params: applied input values at each control step; one row per step.
reference: Verification with best_params: desired state values at each recorded time; not actual states.
times: Verification with best_params: simulation timestamps in seconds, aligned with state rows.
raw_result.success: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether the response passed the settling check; not the success-rate score.
raw_result.unstable: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether the simulator detected divergence or a state-bound violation.
raw_result.unstable_reason: Separate verification simulation with best_params: reason for detected divergence or a state-bound violation, if any.
raw_result.avg_solve_time: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average seconds spent solving one MPC optimization.
raw_result.steps: Verification with best_params: number of control steps completed.

solver_diagnostics.solved: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number of MPC optimizations reported as solved.
solver_diagnostics.solved_inaccurate: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number reported as solved with reduced accuracy.
solver_diagnostics.other: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number with any other recorded solver status.

outputs: Output state names used for verification output-specific MSE and task-scale summaries.

full: Verification with best_params: full-simulation MSE for one output, in verification.outputs order.

task_scale: Verification: mean squared gap between each output starting value and its reference over time; for a constant target this is the squared initial error.
verification.task_scale_basis: mse: task_scale is already mean-squared. Older unmarked RMS task scales are converted once during finalization.

metrics.mse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared difference between actual and target values, over all states and times.
metrics.rmse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: square root of average squared tracking error over all states and times.
metrics.overshoot: Separate verification simulation with best_params: largest amount a state went past its target, divided by that state initial error.
metrics.settling_time: Separate verification simulation with best_params: seconds until error became small and stayed small enough; if not settled, this is the duration-based fallback, not an achieved settling time.
metrics.control_effort: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared applied input over all control steps; smaller means less input use.
metrics.oscillation_count: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number of error sign changes for the state with the largest starting error.

status.success: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether the response passed the settling check; not the success-rate score.
status.settled: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether error became small and passed the minimum-duration and hold checks.
status.is_stable: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether error settled or did not grow significantly from the first to the last quarter; not a formal stability proof.
status.unstable: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether the simulator detected divergence or a state-bound violation.
status.unstable_reason: Separate verification simulation with best_params: reason for detected divergence or a state-bound violation, if any.

verification.average_mpc_solution_time_seconds: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average seconds spent solving one MPC optimization.

solver_diagnostics.solved: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number of MPC optimizations reported as solved.
solver_diagnostics.solved_inaccurate: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number reported as solved with reduced accuracy.
solver_diagnostics.other: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number with any other recorded solver status.
